items.title: DNA traces lead to arrest - the lawyer cuts the evidence
items.summary: The DNA match provided a breakthrough in the investigation of the 21-year-old double murder. The suspect has now been re-arrested and the prosecutor hopes to bring charges in August. - There is nothing that binds him to these deeds, says lawyer Johan Lavås.
items.title_original: Dna-spår ledde till gripande – advokaten sågar bevisen
items.summary_original: Dna-träffen gav ett genombrott i utredningen av det 21 år gamla dubbelmordet. Nu har den misstänkte mannen omhäktats och åklagaren hoppas kunna väcka åtal i augusti. – Det finns inget som binder honom till de här gärningarna, säger advokat Johan Lavås.

items.title: Therefore, Elon Musk has to rub shoulders with right-wing extremists
items.summary: Elon Musk is obsessed with rubbing shoulders with political fringe parties worldwide. Friday's historic IPO of space empire Space X puts his political alliances in an explanatory light.
items.title_original: Därför är Elon Musk tvungen att frottera sig med högerextremister
items.summary_original: Elon Musk är besatt av att frottera sig med politiska ytterkantspartier världen över. Fredagens historiska börsnotering av rymdimperiet Space X sätter hans politiska allianser i ett förklarande ljus.

items.title: Sigrid Melchior: The strike card will be withdrawn immediately
items.summary: In Sweden, students run out to the fragrant lilac. On the continent, the white and purple flowers have already faded and the students have a few weeks left in school. And in Belgium there is a school strike.
items.summary_original: I Sverige springer studenterna ut till doftande syren. På kontinenten har de vita och lila blommorna redan hunnit vissna och eleverna har några veckor kvar i skolan. Och i Belgien är det skolstrejk.

items.title: Joint statement on 10 June 2026
items.summary: Albania, Australia, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, France, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Netherlands, New Zealand, North Macedonia, Norway, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, and the United States of America condemn the lethal plotting and other malign actions in Europe, North America and Australia by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps-Intelligence Organisation, Quds Force and Ministry of Intelligence and Security, including those against Iranian dissidents, journalists and Jewish and Israeli communities and interests. We stand united in our determination to protect our countries and our people against these threats. The Islamic Republic of Iran must halt these actions now.

items.title: State aid application for nuclear power project outside Gävle
items.summary: The Government has received another application for state aid to build new nuclear power in Sweden. The application was submitted by Blykalla, a company seeking to establish a new nuclear power plant in Norrsundet, outside Gävle. This is the second application for state aid received by the Government.

items.title: Maria Malmer Stenergard visits Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates
items.summary: On 8–10 June, Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard is visiting Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates. The visit will focus on the regional crisis and Sweden’s bilateral relations with the Gulf States.

items.title: Sweden bolsters initiatives in support of free and fair elections and democracy in Eastern Europe
items.summary: The Government has presented a support package focused on democracy and free and fair elections in Eastern Europe for 2026 and 2027. The democracy support totals SEK 13.35 million and will go to local elections observation and greater integrity of elections and resilience against disinformation in Armenia and Moldova.

items.title: The Riksbank's business survey: "A new black swan" that risks delaying the recovery
items.summary: According to the large Swedish companies, the economic situation is still weak. Before the war in the Middle East broke out, it was felt that the economy was cautiously improving. The war does not seem to have significantly affected that image. But uncertainty has increased again, which the companies believe risks delaying the already protracted recovery.
items.title_original: Riksbankens företagsundersökning:  ”En ny svart svan” som riskerar att fördröja återhämtningen
items.summary_original: Enligt de svenska storföretagen är konjunkturläget fortfarande svagt. Innan kriget i Mellanöstern bröt ut upplevde man att konjunkturen försiktigt förbättrades. Kriget tycks inte nämnvärt ha påverkat den bilden. Men osäkerheten har ökat igen, vilket företagen menar riskerar att försena den redan utdragna återhämtningen.

items.title: New inquiry appointed to facilitate divestment of property holdings that threaten national security
items.summary: To mitigate security threats posed by certain property holdings, an inquiry has been appointed to propose changes to the Expropriation Act, i.e. the legislation under which a property owner may be compelled to transfer their property holding. The purpose is to ensure that Sweden’s Government can act when a property is at risk of being used in a way that threatens national security.

items.title: Maria Malmer Stenergard met with Ukrainian Minister of Foreign Affairs Andrii Sybiha in Kristianstad
items.summary: On Wednesday 20 May, Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard travelled to Kristianstad along with Ukrainian Minister of Foreign Affairs Andrii Sybiha for a bilateral meeting, a walkabout and a ceremony. Mr Sybiha then undertook other visits in southern Sweden before attending the meeting of NATO Ministers of Foreign Affairs in Helsingborg.

items.title: The monetary policy meeting in September takes place in Gothenburg
items.summary: The Riksbank's executive board holds its monetary policy meeting in Gothenburg on 23 September. The meeting takes place in the premises of the County Administrative Board of Västra Götaland. The decision is announced the following day, 24 September at 9.30am. On the same day, at 10:30 a.m., a press conference about the decision will be held at the West Swedish Chamber of Commerce at Parkgatan 49 in Gothenburg.
items.title_original: Det penningpolitiska mötet i september äger rum i Göteborg
items.summary_original: Riksbankens direktion håller sitt penningpolitiska möte i Göteborg den 23 september. Mötet äger rum i Länsstyrelsen Västra Götalands lokaler. Beslutet offentliggörs dagen därpå, den 24 september klockan 9.30. Samma dag, klockan 10.30, hålls en pressträff om beslutet på Västsvenska Handelskammaren på Parkgatan 49 i Göteborg.

items.title: Minister for Rural Affairs to host ministerial conference on future of forests
items.summary: On 2–3 June, ministers, decision-makers and experts from Europe will convene in Stockholm for FOREST EUROPE’s tenth Ministerial Conference, hosted by Minister for Rural Affairs Peter Kullgren. The Conference also represents the highlight of Sweden’s chairmanship of FOREST EUROPE in 2025–2026.

items.title: The war in the Middle East entails risks for financial stability
items.summary: The war in the Middle East has created turbulence in the financial markets, but the global financial system has functioned well. However, the uncertainty is great. The longer the war continues, the greater the risk that inflation and interest rates will increase at the same time as the economy deteriorates, which could negatively affect several financial markets and actors. There are also several global vulnerabilities that could reinforce each other and exacerbate such a negative development. Sweden has a good starting position, but there are structural risks in the banking system, for example linked to the banks' international dependencies and significant exposures to the commercial real estate sector.
items.title_original: Kriget i Mellanöstern medför risker för den finansiella stabiliteten
items.summary_original: Kriget i Mellanöstern har skapat turbulens på de finansiella marknaderna, men det globala finansiella systemet har fungerat väl. Osäkerheten är dock stor. Ju längre kriget fortgår desto större är risken att inflationen och räntorna ökar samtidigt som konjunkturen försämras, vilket kan påverka flera finansiella marknader och aktörer negativt. Det finns dessutom flera globala sårbarheter som skulle kunna förstärka varandra och förvärra en sådan negativ utveckling. Sverige har ett bra utgångsläge, men det finns strukturella risker i banksystemet exempelvis kopplade till bankernas internationella beroenden och betydande exponeringar mot den kommersiella fastighetssektorn.

items.title: Ministerial visit to Ukraine focused on health care and situation for women
items.summary: On 11–13 May, Minister for Health Care Elisabet Lann and Minister for Gender Equality Nina Larsson visited Kyiv and Lviv. The aim of their visit was to gain insight into Ukraine’s health and medical care and the situation for women during Russia’s full-scale invasion.
